<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

  <li><strong>Tripura campaigning:</strong> Political activity has intensified in Tripura as Chief Minister Manik Saha led a major BJP roadshow, while Congress intensified its efforts in the final stages of the Agartala Municipal Corporation election campaign.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
